g.text: Object Storage: Proxying an Upload vs. a Pre-Signed URL
Same 500MB upload, two paths -- only one keeps your API server out of the byte stream
500MB in from the client, then 500MB back out to storage --
your API server pays double bandwidth AND holds one process/thread
open for the entire transfer. A handful of large uploads at once
can exhaust the tier that's also serving every small unrelated request.
-- the API is never touched by these bytes
Only two tiny signed-URL messages pass through the API.
The 500MB never touches an API process at all -- storage's own
network handles the transfer, which is what it's built for.
